description: Full point-in-time telemetry payload emitted to Redis Pub/Sub on every transaction.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier (UUID v4 hex string).
event_id.title: Event Id

sequence_number.description: Monotonic sequential counter for order verification and drop detection.
sequence_number.title: Sequence Number

event_type.description: Event classification discriminator for subscriber routing.
event_type.title: Event Type

transaction_id.description: Transaction identifier echoed from inbound request.
transaction_id.title: Transaction Id

selected_acquirer.description: The acquirer route selected by the routing engine.
selected_acquirer.title: Selected Acquirer

authorized.description: True if payment authorized successfully, False otherwise.
authorized.title: Authorized

success.description: Binary outcome feedback fed back into the bandit state.
success.title: Success

decline_code.description: Specific decline or error code if payment was not authorized.
decline_code.title: Decline Code

routing_latency_ms.description: Time taken by the router to select arm and compute PID step in ms.
routing_latency_ms.title: Routing Latency Ms

acquirer_latency_ms.description: Network and execution latency to the acquirer in ms.
acquirer_latency_ms.title: Acquirer Latency Ms

total_latency_ms.description: Total round-trip transaction latency in ms.
total_latency_ms.title: Total Latency Ms

thompson_samples.description: Point-in-time Beta distribution samples drawn for all candidate routes.
thompson_samples.title: Thompson Samples

target_allocation.description: Raw bandit target allocation vector prior to PID smoothing.
target_allocation.title: Target Allocation

smoothed_allocation.description: Smoothed traffic allocation vector calculated by PID layer.
smoothed_allocation.title: Smoothed Allocation

allocation_weight.description: The instantaneous smoothed allocation weight assigned to the chosen route.
allocation_weight.title: Allocation Weight

pid_diagnostics.description: Internal PID calculation diagnostics if PID layer was active.
pid_diagnostics.title: Pid Diagnostics

updated_state.description: Updated post-outcome snapshot for selected route (alpha, beta, health_score).
updated_state.title: Updated State
